caption:
Comment ‘REPO’ and I’ll DM a full article breaking down each GitHub and how to use them!

About 51,000 stars landed on these 5 GitHub repos in 7 days. cleanyourtv has your AI agent clean the ads off an Android or Google TV over Wi-Fi and give it an Apple TV-style home screen, and one script undoes it. Filee is a free file converter: drag a file, drop it on a format, all offline. ai-job-search has Claude Code rank job listings against your profile and draft a CV and cover letter for each one, and you still click Apply. MacNativeGames turns your own copy of Zelda into a Mac app. ruflo puts a team of agents inside Claude Code and Codex, with a console that shows what each one is doing. I’m trying cleanyourtv and Filee first. Install commands and my notes on each one are in the DM. Save this one for the weekend.

Follow @buildwithneej for more free AI tools like this.
